tasks.title: Auth, users, roles & entities
tasks.description: Secure authentication foundation with MFA for owner/admin and the core identity tables.
tasks.details: Implement login + MFA. Create tables: users, roles, entities, user_entity_access. Entity isolation primitives so every later query can scope by entity_id.

subtasks.title: Design identity schema
subtasks.details: Define columns + FK relations; entities cover the 8 businesses; user_entity_access maps owner->entities.

subtasks.title: Login + session/JWT
subtasks.details: Password hashing, JWT/session issuance carrying user_id + role.

subtasks.title: MFA for owner/admin
subtasks.details: TOTP or email/SMS OTP enforced for owner/admin roles.

subtasks.title: Entity isolation helper
subtasks.details: Reusable dependency that injects active_entity_id and blocks cross-entity access.

subtasks.title: Seed roles and entities
subtasks.details: Seed owner role and GAK Properties, GIF Properties, Comfort Services, Afro Farm, GAK Commodities, Nour Hammam, Personal, Kenya Ventures.

tasks.title: FastAPI backend + PostgreSQL
tasks.description: Scaffold the FastAPI app, API Gateway routing, and PostgreSQL with shared schema conventions.
tasks.details: FastAPI structure, AWS API Gateway, PostgreSQL connection/migrations. Enforce base columns on every business table: entity_id, source_system, sensitivity_level, created_at, updated_at, status, metadata.

subtasks.title: Scaffold FastAPI app
subtasks.details: App factory, router layout, config via env, health endpoint.

subtasks.title: API Gateway routing
subtasks.details: Gateway routes mapped to the FastAPI handler (Mangum/Lambda).

subtasks.title: PostgreSQL + migrations
subtasks.details: SQLAlchemy session, Alembic migration baseline, connection pooling.

subtasks.title: Shared base model columns
subtasks.description: entity_id, source_system, sensitivity_level, timestamps, status, metadata
subtasks.details: Mixin/base class enforcing the required columns on every business table.

subtasks.title: Auth middleware wiring
subtasks.details: Dependency that validates JWT + loads active_entity_id and permission_scope.

tasks.title: S3 + Secrets Manager + audit logs
tasks.description: Private S3 buckets with presigned URLs, AWS Secrets Manager for credentials, and the audit_logs table.
tasks.details: Private S3 buckets only, presigned URLs only. Store all tokens/credentials in Secrets Manager (never in frontend/GitHub/logs/prompts). Create audit_logs table.

subtasks.title: Private S3 + presigned URLs
subtasks.details: Block public access; helper to mint short-lived presigned GET/PUT URLs.

subtasks.title: Secrets Manager integration
subtasks.details: Connector tokens and DB/AI keys read from Secrets Manager at runtime.

subtasks.title: audit_logs table + writer
subtasks.details: audit_logs schema + helper invoked on AI/document/sync/approval events.

subtasks.title: Secret-hygiene guardrails
subtasks.details: Log redaction + checks preventing secrets in responses, logs, and AI prompts.

tasks.title: Business switcher backend
tasks.description: APIs to list owner-accessible entities and switch active business context.
tasks.details: GET /api/entities/available-to-me, POST /api/businesses/switch, GET /api/businesses/{entity_id}/modules. Loads active_entity_id + allowed modules/apps/documents/ai_agents/actions. All Businesses mode returns summaries only.

subtasks.title: List available entities
subtasks.details: Return entities the owner can access, derived from user_entity_access.

subtasks.title: Switch active business
subtasks.details: Validate owner access, set active_entity_id in session context.

subtasks.title: Context loader
subtasks.details: Load allowed_modules, allowed_apps, allowed_documents, allowed_ai_agents, allowed_actions.

subtasks.title: All Businesses summary mode
subtasks.details: Return cross-business KPIs/health/activity summaries; no blind raw retrieval.

subtasks.title: Modules endpoint
subtasks.details: Expose enabled modules for the selected entity.

tasks.title: Owner Command Center frontend
tasks.description: Simple owner-first frontend: sidebar, top bar, command center cards.
tasks.details: Left sidebar business switcher + owner nav. Top bar (selected business, search, notifications, pending approvals count, sync badge, voice, profile). Cards: pending approvals, urgent emails, today meetings, QuickBooks snapshot, doc processing, failed syncs, pipeline health, activity, app health. Dashboard reloads on business switch.

subtasks.title: App shell + sidebar
subtasks.details: Left sidebar with business list and Command Center/Ask Hermes/etc. navigation.

subtasks.title: Top bar
subtasks.details: Selected business, global search, pending approvals count, sync health badge, Hermes voice button.

subtasks.title: Command center cards
subtasks.details: Pending approvals, urgent emails, today meetings, QuickBooks snapshot, failed syncs, pipeline/activity health.

subtasks.title: Switch -> dashboard reload
subtasks.details: On business switch, refetch dashboard scoped to the selected entity.

subtasks.title: Login + protected routes
subtasks.details: Owner login (with MFA), session handling, route protection.

tasks.title: Hermes Jarvis chat API
tasks.description: Owner-facing AI chat endpoint with business context, history and sources/confidence.
tasks.details: POST /api/hermes/jarvis/chat, GET /context, GET /history. Tables: hermes_sessions, hermes_messages. Every request carries active_entity_id. Returns sources, confidence, approval-required badge. Drafts emails but never sends.

subtasks.title: Sessions/messages schema
subtasks.details: Persist chat sessions and messages scoped by entity_id.

subtasks.title: Chat endpoint
subtasks.details: Carry active_entity_id; verify user/entity before answering.

subtasks.title: Context + history
subtasks.details: Return current business context and recent questions.

subtasks.title: Sources + confidence
subtasks.details: Response includes sources panel, confidence badge, approval-required badge.

subtasks.title: Draft-only email guardrail
subtasks.details: Email drafting returns a draft + approval request, never sends.

tasks.title: Hermes Agent runtime
tasks.description: Backend runtime that validates permissions/scope, routes to agents, writes audit logs.
tasks.details: POST /api/hermes/agent/run, GET /runs. Validate permission + entity scope before any tool call. Chief AI Orchestrator routes to agents. Tables: hermes_agent_runs, hermes_tool_calls, ai_runs. Creates approval records; writes audit logs. Cannot move money, delete/overwrite files, send email/DocuSign, or change QuickBooks.

subtasks.title: Agent-run schema
subtasks.details: Track runs, tool calls, and AI invocations per entity.

subtasks.title: Run endpoints
subtasks.details: Execute a task via the runtime and list past runs.

subtasks.title: Permission + scope gate
subtasks.details: Check user_id, role, active_entity_id, permission_scope, sensitivity before acting.

subtasks.title: Orchestrator + agent registry
subtasks.details: Chief AI Orchestrator selects agents from an Agent Registry.

subtasks.title: Approvals + audit logging
subtasks.description: Create approval records, write audit logs
subtasks.details: Sensitive actions create approval records; every action writes audit logs.

subtasks.title: Hard prohibitions
subtasks.details: Runtime cannot move money, delete/overwrite files, send email/DocuSign, or change QuickBooks.

tasks.title: Document upload + Pinecone ingestion
tasks.description: Upload/store documents in S3 and index them in Pinecone with entity metadata.
tasks.details: POST /api/documents/upload, GET /api/documents, GET /{id}. Tables: documents, document_chunks. Ingestion: S3 -> PostgreSQL row -> extraction/OCR -> chunking -> embedding -> Pinecone upsert. Vectors carry entity_id, business_name/type, document_type, source_system, sensitivity_level, access_roles, region, version, is_active.

subtasks.title: Documents schema
subtasks.details: Document + chunk tables with entity_id and sensitivity_level.

subtasks.title: Upload -> S3 + DB row
subtasks.details: Store raw file in private S3, create PostgreSQL document row.

subtasks.title: Extraction + chunking
subtasks.details: Extract text (OCR for scans), chunk for embedding.

subtasks.title: Embed + Pinecone upsert
subtasks.details: Embed chunks; upsert with chunk_id, document_id, entity_id, business_name/type, document_type, source_system, sensitivity_level, access_roles, region, version, is_active.

subtasks.title: List/get documents
subtasks.details: List and fetch document metadata + status.

tasks.title: AI document Q&A with filtered retrieval
tasks.description: Source-backed document Q&A via Pinecone with mandatory safety filters.
tasks.details: POST /api/search/vector, /global, /api/ai/ask-document, GET /api/pinecone/entity-status/{id}. Pinecone Retrieval + Document Intelligence Agents. No query without entity_id + role/access + sensitivity filters. No cross-entity retrieval except Owner All Businesses mode. All retrieval logged.

subtasks.title: Retrieval agent + filters
subtasks.details: Pinecone Retrieval Agent rejects any query missing entity_id, role/access, or sensitivity filters.

subtasks.title: Vector search endpoints
subtasks.details: Filtered vector + global search APIs.

subtasks.title: Ask-document endpoint
subtasks.details: Source-backed answers with citations and confidence.

subtasks.title: Entity status endpoint
subtasks.details: Report indexed/active vector counts per entity.

subtasks.title: Retrieval logging + isolation
subtasks.details: Log every retrieval; cross-entity only in Owner All Businesses mode.

tasks.title: Google Drive sync
tasks.description: Connect Google Drive via Maton.ai/Lambda and feed files into document ingestion.
tasks.details: Drive connector reads tokens from Secrets Manager. Tables: connected_apps, integration_connections, sync_jobs. POST /api/integrations/{app_key}/sync. New/changed files trigger ingestion. Google Drive Agent.

subtasks.title: Connector schema
subtasks.details: Tables tracking app connections and sync jobs per entity.

subtasks.title: Drive connector
subtasks.details: Authenticate Drive, read token from Secrets Manager, fetch file list/changes.

subtasks.title: Sync endpoint
subtasks.details: Trigger a Drive sync for the active entity.

subtasks.title: Trigger ingestion
subtasks.details: New/changed files enqueue the document ingestion flow.

subtasks.title: Sync status + errors
subtasks.details: Update sync_jobs with status and capture failures for the pipeline dashboard.

tasks.title: Gmail sync
tasks.description: Sync Gmail into classified, entity-scoped email records; draft replies only.
tasks.details: Gmail Inbox Agent: classify by business, detect urgent/tenant/vendor/CPA/farm, draft replies (never auto-send), create follow-ups, route sensitive replies to approval. Tables: email_threads, email_messages.

subtasks.title: Email schema
subtasks.details: Entity-scoped email tables with classification + sensitivity fields.

subtasks.title: Gmail connector
subtasks.details: Fetch threads/messages; never store secrets in logs.

subtasks.title: Classification
subtasks.details: Classify business, urgent, tenant/vendor/CPA/farm; attach to entity records.

subtasks.title: Drafts + follow-ups
subtasks.description: Draft replies, create tasks, no auto-send
subtasks.details: Generate draft replies and follow-up tasks; never send automatically.

subtasks.title: Route sensitive to approval
subtasks.details: Sensitive replies create approval records via the approval queue.

tasks.title: Google Calendar sync
tasks.description: Sync calendar into meeting/deadline records with briefs and action items.
tasks.details: Calendar & Meetings Agent: meeting briefs, summaries, action items, follow-ups, lease/CPA deadline tracking. Table: calendar_events. Includes Google Meet/Fathom context where available.

subtasks.title: Calendar schema
subtasks.details: Entity-scoped meetings/deadlines table.

subtasks.title: Calendar connector
subtasks.details: Pull events via Maton.ai/Lambda; token from Secrets Manager.

subtasks.title: Briefs + summaries
subtasks.details: Prepare briefs; summarize with Google Meet/Fathom transcript context.

subtasks.title: Action items + follow-ups
subtasks.details: Extract action items, create follow-up tasks, track missed follow-ups.

subtasks.title: Deadline tracking
subtasks.details: Track lease and CPA deadlines from calendar + documents.

tasks.title: Google Docs/Sheets/Forms sync (Afro Farm)
tasks.description: Sync Docs/Sheets/Forms to support Afro Farm operational basics.
tasks.details: Read Afro Farm operational data: submitted/missing reports, daily activity, labor/payroll, fuel/inventory/spray/harvest/security. Table: farm_form_submissions. Afro Farm Operations Agent. Bridge AFK Apps Script automations.

subtasks.title: Farm submissions schema
subtasks.details: Entity-scoped table for Afro Farm form/sheet data.

subtasks.title: Sheets/Forms/Docs connectors
subtasks.details: Connectors for Forms submissions, Sheets trackers, Docs reports.

subtasks.title: Report tracking
subtasks.details: Detect submitted/missing daily reports and flag gaps.

subtasks.title: Daily activity summary
subtasks.details: Summarize labor/payroll, fuel, inventory, spray, harvest, security.

subtasks.title: Bridge Apps Script
subtasks.details: Bridge existing Google Apps Script automations into the pipeline.

tasks.title: QuickBooks read-only sync
tasks.description: Read-only QuickBooks financial summaries per entity. No writes in MVP.
tasks.details: GET /api/quickbooks/status, /entity/{id}/overview|profit-and-loss|expenses|ar-aging|ap-aging, POST /sync. Table: quickbooks_snapshots. QuickBooks Finance Agent: P&L, income, expenses, AR/AP, cash snapshot, flag unusual transactions, monthly brief. Read-only first; future writes require approval.

subtasks.title: Snapshots schema
subtasks.details: Entity-mapped financial snapshots table.

subtasks.title: Read-only connector
subtasks.details: Read-only QuickBooks sync; POST /api/quickbooks/sync; token from Secrets Manager.

subtasks.title: Overview + P&L endpoints
subtasks.details: GET status, /entity/{id}/overview, /profit-and-loss.

subtasks.title: Expenses + aging endpoints
subtasks.details: GET /entity/{id}/expenses, /ar-aging, /ap-aging.

subtasks.title: Finance agent brief
subtasks.details: Cash snapshot, flag unusual transactions, monthly owner brief, entity comparison.

tasks.title: Connected Apps dashboard
tasks.description: Dashboard listing connected apps and their status per entity.
tasks.details: GET /api/integrations, /status, /entity/{entity_id}. Connected Apps Health Agent. Surfaces the priority-22 MVP apps and connection state.

subtasks.title: Integrations list
subtasks.details: List connected apps + connection state for the active entity.

subtasks.title: Status endpoints
subtasks.details: Aggregate + per-entity integration status.

tasks.title: App Health dashboard
tasks.description: Per-app health/status badges, last-sync times, and error logs.
tasks.details: GET /api/integrations/{app_key}/logs. Surface health badges, last sync, failure reasons. App Health Agent. Feeds the sync health badge in the owner top bar.

tasks.title: Activity Analytics
tasks.description: Activity events and analytics across AI, apps, documents and tasks.
tasks.details: Table: activity_events. GET /api/activity/overview, /entity/{id}, /ai, /documents, /integrations. Activity Analytics Agent. Cross-business summaries in All Businesses mode.

tasks.title: Data Pipeline dashboard
tasks.description: Sync/indexing pipeline health with failed-job visibility and safe retries.
tasks.details: Table: pipeline_runs. GET /api/pipeline/overview, /entity/{id}, /failed-jobs, POST /api/pipeline/retry/{job_id}. Data Pipeline Monitoring Agent. Updated by ingestion and connector sync flows. High-risk retries route to approval.

tasks.title: Approval queue
tasks.description: Approval records and gates that block sensitive actions until owner approves.
tasks.details: Table: approvals. GET /api/approvals, /{id}, POST /{id}/approve|reject|edit. Approval Agent. Gates send email, send DocuSign, QuickBooks writes, external share, sensitive export, subscription cancel, permission change, high-risk retry. Backend executes only after approval; audit log records final action.

subtasks.title: Approvals schema
subtasks.details: Approval records with entity_id, action type, payload, status, decision.

subtasks.title: List/get approvals
subtasks.details: List pending approvals and fetch one.

subtasks.title: Decision endpoints
subtasks.details: Owner approves, rejects, or edits a proposed action.

subtasks.title: Sensitive-action gate
subtasks.details: Gate send email, send DocuSign, QuickBooks writes, external share, sensitive export, subscription cancel, permission change, high-risk retry.

subtasks.title: Execute after approval
subtasks.details: Backend executes the action only after approval; audit log records the final action.

tasks.title: Owner morning briefing
tasks.description: Aggregated daily briefing summarizing dashboards for the owner.
tasks.details: POST /api/hermes/jarvis/briefing. Hermes Jarvis composes a morning brief: pending approvals, urgent emails, today meetings, QuickBooks snapshot, failed syncs, pipeline + activity summary, lease/deadline + farm status. Uses summaries first (All Businesses), drills in on request.
